verdict.rationale: The SDK ships example agents: TypeScript apps in the claude-agent-sdk-demos repo and Python recipes in the Claude Cookbook. Its programmatic query() loop runs agents to completion "without manual intervention", and a community user reports building a headless automated workflow around `claude -p`. However, no evidence documents a terminal command or headless mode for running the examples, or using that output to verify a build. missing for 10: documented headless run instructions for the example agents, an explicit verification or test workflow for agent-built output, independent hands-on corroboration of running the examples headlessly.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run the framework's example agents headlessly from a terminal so an agent can verify what it just built
